data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2017: GBP 10.1m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2017: predominantly from the nuclear property class).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Extensive review undertaken following the accident; exposure considered limited and subject to improved safety standards.
Referenced as 2017 hurricane activity; the Syndicate noted performance and planning; no significant claims advices expected to nuclear sites from these events.

named_events.loss_description: Only one significant core melt nuclear event paid by the insurance market, referenced historically.
Referenced as the catalyst for extensive exposure review; exposure considered limited.
Largest insured windstorm loss to date referenced (warehouse on nuclear site) with losses in the region of $200m; no damage to the nuclear unit.
All the plants in the vicinity of tracks of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in 2017 performed to plan and, as expected, there were no significant claims advices from these events.
Referenced as 2018 hurricane activity; performed to plan and no significant claims advices from these events.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate held opening gross claims reserves of GBP 46.84m at 1 January 2018. During 2018 the Syndicate recorded a release in prior year technical reserves of GBP 8.3m (predominantly in the nuclear property class) driven by favourable prior year claims development. This resulted in a net reduction in the gross claims outstanding to GBP 39.661m at 31 December 2018. The movement is described as a release and is mainly attributable to the Property (nuclear) portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2017: GBP 10.1m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2017: predominantly from the nuclear property class).
The reduction in net incurred claims is driven by favourable prior year development of GBP 8.8m (2017: GBP 10.1m).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 8.3m (assumed gross). The technical reserves reconciliation (Note 16) shows gross claims outstanding fell from GBP 46.840m to GBP 39.661m (a movement of GBP 7.179m) - differences arise from exchange adjustments, claims paid and other movements. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 28) and was used as a cross-check. All monetary amounts are reported in GBP, original tables are in GBP 000.
